description:
Which of a print's events to read.

An empty `kinds` means every kind rather than no kinds, and an absent
`limit` means [`DEFAULT_HISTORY_WINDOW`].

kinds.description: The kinds to read; empty means every kind.

limit.description: How many events to answer; absent means [`DEFAULT_HISTORY_WINDOW`].

print_id.description: The print to read the history of.

since.description: The earliest instant to read from, inclusive.

until.description: The latest instant to read to, inclusive.
